target_invariant: Runtime state may record progress only when the intended side effects are durably represented by runtime effect records, or when a path is explicitly documented as synchronous/direct because immediate deterministic output is required.

acceptance_coverage.criterion: advanceCase records intended dispatch effects durably before workers execute them
acceptance_coverage.notes: Normal and branch work-item dispatch create workitem.dispatch runtime effects with case/work_item links and stable idempotency before transport delivery.

acceptance_coverage.criterion: adapter side effects are durable where safe
acceptance_coverage.notes: Only bindings marked execution=async_effect enqueue adapter.invoke; sync bindings stay direct when runtime needs immediate output.

acceptance_coverage.criterion: connector notifications can be represented and delivered through outbox
acceptance_coverage.notes: connector.send_message effects now have enqueue/handler/dedupe/retry/dead-letter coverage; direct Action Spine sends remain explicit operator actions.

acceptance_coverage.criterion: subscription activation/cancellation and reminder scheduling are durable where safe
acceptance_coverage.notes: Durable subscription/reminder rows remain source of truth; outbox effects activate scheduler/listener resources and skip stale creates.

acceptance_coverage.criterion: each effect has bounded status, retry, idempotency, and dead-letter semantics
acceptance_coverage.notes: RuntimeEffectRecord status machine covers pending/in_flight/succeeded/failed/retry/dead_letter/cancelled with lock recovery and max-attempt guards.

acceptance_coverage.criterion: case/work item observability shows failed side effects
acceptance_coverage.notes: Runtime effect state changes emit timeline evidence; monitor/alert views surface retry/failed/dead_letter effects with visible-case filtering.

acceptance_coverage.criterion: recovery command can replay pending/failed effects safely
acceptance_coverage.notes: Recovery API/CLI requires actor/reason, records audit links for success and structured errors, and preserves in-flight worker ownership.

direct_paths_kept.reason: Runtime needs immediate deterministic output for auto-complete, payload updates, and gateway conditions.
State mutation is the durable source of truth and no scheduler resource is needed for manual waits.

direct_paths_kept.path: explicit operator connector.send_message Action Spine calls
direct_paths_kept.reason: Operator-triggered external sends remain deliberate actions; runtime-originated connector notifications can use connector.send_message effects.

review_commands: PATH=/home/ubuntu/.bun/bin:$PATH bun test --timeout 30000 tests/runtime-effect-outbox.test.ts tests/connector-outbox.test.ts tests/workitem-dispatch-outbox.test.ts tests/adapter-outbox.test.ts tests/scheduled-effects-outbox.test.ts tests/runtime-effect-recovery.test.ts tests/operational-alerts.test.ts

closure_decision.notes: This reconciles the #678 umbrella. Production release still follows the #686 checklist and #812 terminal-case gate.
